preserved_w3a_result.statement: nominal HDP: silent->dormant, weak activity->low-gain, stronger activity->near-critical/unstable
preserved_w3a_result.note: Do not select I_tonic=6 merely for passing stability; characterize the model.

scientific_question: What parameter domain permits simultaneously active, bounded, nontrivial, robust HDP?

dimensionless_coordinates.note: Gamma_HDP is explanatory; regime label uses implementation-faithful Floquet only

regime_labels.X: unclassified (no validated periodic orbit or timescale violation)

frozen_gates_before_scan.period_validation: period >= 2 and spike present in period window
frozen_gates_before_scan.nontrivial: L_HDP > 1e-6 (prospective null floor, not tuned to create a region)

D_useful.empty_interpretation: linear HDP law tau_W*omega_dot = kappa_W*(H_pre-H_post) - lambda_W*omega may be insufficient; change law in new protocol

selection_rule_for_W3.timing: only after W3b identifies prospective admissible domain
selection_rule_for_W3.rule: max m_F among S-regime points subject to L_HDP > L_min and r_tau > 1
selection_rule_for_W3.forbidden: using eventual memory score to choose operating point

margin_correction.issue: W3a period=1 false positives caused ambiguous Floquet margins
margin_correction.resolution: w3a_margin_audit.json; W3b uses corrected m_F and period>=2
margin_correction.reduced_J_red: explanatory only, not stability classifier in active regime

frozen_lattice.description: Coarse preregistered factorial lattice (fixed before scan; not tuned post-hoc)

aggregate_quantities.N_X: count of active but stability-unresolved (regime X with mean_syn > active threshold)

interpretation_branches.N_S_gt_0: nonempty robust active domain; apply selection rule; consider W3
interpretation_branches.N_S_eq_0_and_N_X_eq_0: genuine negative parameter-domain result; version new F_W
interpretation_branches.N_S_eq_0_and_N_X_gt_0: no demonstrated robust domain; active regimes unresolved; next step W3c orbit characterization
